title: Right / left 11-11 (agglomerative)
summary: Same 11/11 recording as experiment 06 (right / left arm movements among natural ones), grouped with agglomerative instead of k-means. Truth (video times + Andrew's notes) is used only to evaluate.
result: 11/19 R/L correct with k = 2 (ARI 0.00); best setting 15/19 (k = 4)
method: Agglomerative (Ward) clustering, k = 2, on one feature card per detected event
